Our story

Perched just above Ella’s Railway Station Road, we’ve welcomed travellers and locals since 2010. Built from upcycled timber, brick and warm light, it’s a laid-back space that comes alive each evening with clinking glasses and live music.

Mountain vibes,
warm light.Come for a long lunch — stay for sundowners and the band.
